steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan.
In a large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Mix in water and egg, then stir in cake mix. Finally, mix in nuts and chocolate chips. Spread mixture into pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in the preheated oven. Cool completely before cutting into bars.

raw_recipe.headline: Bar Cookies from Cake Mix
raw_recipe.description: A bar cookie that has chocolate chips and nuts. This is easy and delicious.
raw_recipe.name: Bar Cookies from Cake Mix

review.reviewBody: I made these last night. They were a big hit with my family. I used a yellow cake mix because it was what I had on hand. I added a little vanilla extract, two eggs, and a little oil. Delicious! Very easy to make, and a very quick clean up.
Perfect for a crowd of kids without fussing. I used 1/3 cup water and added mini-m&m's in a yellow cake mix. Baked for 25 minutes.

EASTER: Doubled with 2 strawberry mixes, 1-C butter, 1-C brown sugar, 1/2-C water, 3 eggs, & 1-12oz-bag Easter M&Ms cooked in an 11"x17" cookie sheet...cut 5x8=40 ~2x2 bars...about 30 min...cooled, glaze drizzled & sprinkled with easter sugar

I am a lazy baker and a big fan of good easy dessert recipes. I have made this several times for that reason. I love it and so does my family. We could eat this "until the cows come home." I substituted with a yellow cake mix, left out the nuts and sprinkled the top with sea salt after cooling. I've doubled it for a half sheet pan of bars for the church bake sale.

I have made this so many ways and times we love it! I do add more water 1/3 cup + 1 TBLSP. I also have a grandson with an egg allergy (no whites) so I made this with 2 egg yokes instead they turned out fantastic. We couldn't tell the difference. I do reduce the cooking time to 30 min. I start checking them at 25 do not overcook these they will get hard. Very easy quick dessert YUMMY!! thanks for sharing

NOTE: they are thick to spread in pan

Tried this recipe tonight and it was a hit! I increased the water to 4 T. as others indicated. I also baked it in two, 9" cake pans instead of a 9 x 13 for 25 minutes at 325 degrees (my pans are dark, so I reduced the temperature by 25 degrees). Then, I wrote "Happy Birthday" in frosting on the top. Very easy recipe!

Terrific soft chewy bars. I think I had success because I baked them at 325 on convection for 30 min until golden. After reading other reviews, I used yellow cake mix, 1/3 c. light brown sugar, 2 eggs, 1/4 c. water and 1 1/2 c mixture of white and dark choc chips.

I made this as written except I used a funfetti cake because that's what I had on hand and I used two eggs and 4t of water per reviews. This was very good and my entire family loved it. I would say it is best described as one reviewer said as a cross between a brownie and a cookie.
 The only reason I didn't give it five stars was because it was VERY sweet. This is coming from a person who is a big sweets eater. It is very seldom that I have to stop eating something because of it being so rich and sweet but that was the case with these bars. I think next time I will try it without the brown sugar and see how it turns out. There will be a next time for sure as I plan on trying it with lots of other cake mix flavor/mix in combinations. Thanks for a great recipe.

This recipe is a great starting point but I did take the hints of others here and added an additional egg, 2 more tablespoons of water, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil and a teaspoon of vanilla extract. The bars did take a little longer to bake, however (about 40 minutes), but they were perfect.
Used coffee for the liquid -- about a quarter cup -- and half chocolate chips, half chocolate expresso M&M's. Delicious!

My son said these were the best. As others had commented, I chose to alter by using 2 eggs, 1/4 cup water, 1/2 tsp vanilla, and baked for only 18 minutes since my little oven cooks very fast. Also my cake mix that I just happened to have was 16.5 oz., I added the entire 12 oz bag of chocolate chips and it turned out very well.
simple to make, chewy, packs well
A butter yellow cake mix with mini semi sweet chocolate chips is a 5 ⭐️ all day!
We substituted blueberries for choc chips and added lemon juice. Extra water as others have. Yum
I did pecans and added 1/2 cup coconut

I made this recipe to use a yellow cake mix expiring soon. I used the ingredients as called for, only adding a bit of vanilla extract. It baked for 30 min in a glass 9 x 13. It was easy to prepare. It tastes decadent!
Absolutely delicious and addicting!
Butter pecan cake mix (just no extra sugar added) melted chocolate on top and pecan halves. Very yummy

These are so good! I made with butter pecan cake mix and butterscotch chips. Think blonde brownies. I added 4 tbs of water as was suggested by others and I baked for 25". These will definitely be my go to for brownies. They are so chewy and tasty!

I used yellow cake mix and did increase the water like was suggeted and also added 2T oil. Since my family doesn't really like walnuts or pecans, in addition to the chocolate chips, I used chopped almonds (1/2 in batter and 1/2 on top) with a generous drizzle on the top of caramel ice cream topping. Turned out like a salted caramel flavor!. It was super easy!
